description.zh: 在 p–V 图上用等温与绝热四步围成回路：净功是围出的面积，Q_h = W + Q_c，效率上限 1 − T_c/T_h；倒转后是制冷机，COP = T_c/(T_h − T_c)。可逆理想气体模型，真实热机效率更低。
description.en: Four isothermal and adiabatic steps close into a loop on a p–V diagram: net work is the enclosed area, Q_h = W + Q_c, the efficiency ceiling is 1 − T_c/T_h, and reversed it is a refrigerator with COP = T_c/(T_h − T_c). A reversible ideal-gas model; real engines do worse.

label.zh: 功是 p–V 曲线下面积

reason.zh: 气体对外做功 W = ∫P dV，是功—能量关系在气体上的具体形式；一圈的净功等于回路围出的面积。
reason.en: The work done by a gas, W = ∫P dV, is the work–energy relation for a gas; the net work of a cycle equals the area enclosed by the loop.

label.zh: Q_h = W + Q_c 的能量账
label.en: The energy ledger Q_h = W + Q_c

reason.zh: 一圈回来内能不变，吸的热一部分变成功、其余排给冷源，是能量守恒在热机上的账本。
reason.en: After one full cycle the internal energy is unchanged, so the heat taken in becomes work or is rejected to the cold sink, energy conservation applied to a heat engine.

title.zh: 热机的效率为什么有上限？
title.en: Why is there a ceiling on heat-engine efficiency?

ask.zh: p–V 图上回路围出的面积是什么？净功和吸热、放热什么关系？
ask.en: On a p–V diagram, what is the area enclosed by the loop? How do net work, heat in and heat out relate?

ask.zh: 效率上限 1 − T_c/T_h 由什么决定？提高热源温度还是降低冷源温度更有效？
ask.en: What sets the efficiency ceiling 1 − T_c/T_h? Is raising the hot temperature or lowering the cold one more effective?

reveal.zh: 净功就是回路面积，Q_h = W + Q_c；可逆循环的效率只由两端温度定，1 − T_c/T_h 是任何热机都越不过的上限。
reveal.en: Net work is the enclosed area, with Q_h = W + Q_c; a reversible cycle's efficiency depends only on the two temperatures, and 1 − T_c/T_h is a ceiling no heat engine can pass.
